newsitem.title: USA: Manhattan Bagel signs franchise agreement.
newsitem.headline: Manhattan Bagel signs franchise agreement.

text.p: -- Manhattan Bagel Co Inc said on Thursday that it had signed a franchise development agreement with a newly formed subsidiary of privately-owned D&W Food Centers Inc for 11 Michigan counties.
The agreement calls for Michigan Bagel LLC to develop at least 20 Manhattan Bagel units over a 36-month period within D&W's supermarkets or in freestanding locations.
"The agreement with Michigan Bagel continues Manhattan Bagel's move into supermarket locations," Manhattan Bagel said in statement.
Full-bake Manhattan Bagel units are currently operating in Vons and Pavilions supermarkets in southern California, among other markets, the company said.
Manhattan Bagel franchises, licenses or operates more than 320 stores in 18 states.
